notes: International list = EFL 'International Broadcasters for the 2026/27 season' (EFL Fixtures table, covers Sky Bet Championship, League One, League Two); EFL says additional markets will be added as confirmed. Internationally, any game shown live in the UK by Sky Sports is eligible for international broadcast, plus one additional Saturday 3pm fixture. UK: Sky Sports/Sky Sports+ main live partner; ITV1/ITVX simulcast 10 Championship games free-to-air in 2026/27 (last season of the Sky-ITV arrangement); ITV highlights. No broadcaster listed by the EFL for Ireland, Russia, Belarus or several Pacific nations. Some free-to-air flags (SportyTV, Douyin) are inferred from broadcaster type.

broadcasters.note: Sky Sports is the EFL's UK partner (5-year deal from 2024/25, GBP 935m): over 1,000 of 1,891 EFL/Carabao Cup/EFL Trophy games, on Sky Sports channels or Sky Sports+ (Sky subscription or NOW). ITV simulcasts 10 Championship matches per season free-to-air on ITV1/ITVX (Sky-ITV deal runs to end of 2026/27) and shows EFL highlights (ITV4/ITV, on demand on ITVX). Saturday 3pm blackout: not every match is live in the UK.
